about: Dizzy Llama is a small-town bar, pool hall and sports bar at 2220 N La Salle St in Navasota.
Tracee Weigand opened it in 2012 after bartending since she was 19. There are two pool tables, games on the TV and a big fishbowl drink regulars tell newcomers to try.
Customers have given it 4.6 stars across 121 Google reviews.
